name: Jtekt India Ltd
title: Jtekt India Ltd - 520057 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity built ahead of demand: CVJ line 2 at 27% utilisation and MS Gear line 6 at 21%, with management targeting full use in 1–1.5 years; FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 7.5% from 7.6%.

utilisation.quote: CVJ Line 2, which was set up in November '25 with a capacity of around 370,000, is just 27% utilized today.

capex.quote: It will not be as huge as we have done in the last 2 years. But yes, Gujarat is one location where we need to spend the money going forward over the next 1 or 2 years.

triggers.label: CVJ Line 2 utilisation 27%
triggers.quote: CVJ Line 2, which was set up in November '25 with a capacity of around 370,000, is just 27% utilized today.

triggers.label: Gujarat plant capex ~INR100 crore more
triggers.quote: So maybe another INR100 crores for that location and then other normal capital expenditure.

triggers.label: MS Gear Line 5 at 106%
triggers.quote: MS Gear Line 5 Dharuhera, which we installed in last year is already touched 106% capacity utilization.

triggers.label: Brazil order ~70,000 units this year
triggers.quote: we expect that about 70,000 units will be supplied during t h e c u r r e n t y e a r

guidance.value: INR800 crore additional over FY27 (theoretical, 10% market growth plus exports)
guidance.quote: we can easily cater about INR800 crores of extra business from this.

guidance.value: about 70,000 units this year, 100,000-150,000 next year
guidance.quote: we will start touching about -- next year, we will touch about may say 100,0 00 to 150,000
we expect that whatever capacities we have set up will be 100% utilized over the next 1 year or maybe 1.5 years

prior_guidance_check.metric: Incremental revenue of ~INR1,000 crore by FY27 from new capacity

red_flags.label: ROCE fell from 16% to 10% with fixed asset turnover ~2.2x
red_flags.quote: our return on capital employed was 16% in F '24, which is now down to 10%.

red_flags.label: Forex gain booked in material cost, margin flattered by accounting
red_flags.quote: imports were booked at a slightl y higher price, which costed us about INR62 million, 0.23%.

red_flags.label: Honda volumes down ~30%, customer concentration
red_flags.quote: when we look at Honda stand-alone, th eir business in the passenger vehicle segment declined by a massive 30%.
